result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so it no longer uses hard-coded file names. It now takes the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) in that order. For each it builds the name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that names the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files. It reads each file under that name and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With default names the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written again when `git-history.txt` exists.

`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile` succeeded. I didn't run any tests or an actual export, so the renamed case isn't checked end to end.

I left `LandscapeAnalyzer.java` alone. It also has hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` names (lines 292–296), including `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. That is outside this task, but a renamed aspect would likely trip it up too.
